description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (55), grants [Quick Cast 2] and [Last Stand] to all allies, grants [Attach Holy Stacking] and [Attach Holy] to the user

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Attach Holy Stacking
description.text: Allow to stack Attach Holy, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%
